p.title: Federal or unitary?
p.challenge: Test Sri Lanka: answer each question for it. Then press ⟲ and test Belgium after 1993

nodes.info: Federalism: power divided between a central authority and its constituent units.

nodes.text: Two or more levels of government?
nodes.info: Choose Yes or No.
In a unitary system the sub-units are subordinate to the central government.
In a unitary system there is only one level of government.
Sri Lanka remains a unitary system.

nodes.text: Federal: each level has its own powers
nodes.info: Powers are written in the constitution; both levels must agree to change basic provisions; courts act as umpire. Belgium became federal in 1993.

words.meaning: Defence is of national importance: Union List.

Both levels can make laws on education. If laws conflict, the Union law prevails.
Marriage is on the Concurrent List.
Forest is on the Concurrent List.
Computer software is in no list: a residuary subject, so the Union government makes laws on it.

p.title: State party or national party?

nodes.text: A party registered with the EC
nodes.info: Every party must register with the Election Commission. Recognised parties get a unique symbol.

nodes.text: National test: 6% votes and 4 Lok Sabha seats?
nodes.info: At least 6% of votes in Lok Sabha elections or in Assembly elections in four states, AND at least four Lok Sabha seats.
Recognised as a national party (textbook rule).
At least 6% of the total votes in one state's Assembly election.
At least two seats in that state's Assembly.
Registered, but without the special facilities of a recognised party.
Recognised as a state party. Often called a 'regional party'.
Registered, but without the special facilities of a recognised party.
